declaration.content:
STEP 7 OF 8
Declaration

DECLARATION BY THE APPLICANT

We hereby solemnly declare that:

1. The information furnished in this application form and the supporting documents submitted herewith is true, correct, and complete to the best of our knowledge and belief. No relevant information has been concealed or misrepresented.

2. We understand that any false statement, misrepresentation, or suppression of material facts shall render this application liable to outright rejection, or shall result in cancellation of the recognition already granted, without prejudice to any other action that the Department of Tourism, Government of Odisha, may deem fit to initiate.

3. We undertake to comply with all provisions of the Tourism Policy 2023 and the Tourism Service Provider (TSP) Guidelines 2026 issued by the Department of Tourism, Government of Odisha, and any amendments, circulars, or orders issued thereunder.

4. We undertake to maintain the quality, standards, professional conduct, and integrity of tourism services as prescribed by the Department of Tourism, Government of Odisha, at all times.

5. We agree to submit to periodic inspections, surprise checks, and audits as directed by the Department of Tourism, and undertake to cooperate fully with officers duly authorised to inspect the premises, records, and operations.

6. We undertake not to engage in any activity that is illegal, unethical, or in any manner detrimental to the tourism industry or prejudicial to the reputation and image of Odisha as a tourist destination.

7. We acknowledge that the recognition granted under the TSP Guidelines 2026 is subject to renewal and continued compliance with the prescribed norms and conditions, and that non-compliance may result in suspension or cancellation of recognition at the sole discretion of the competent authority.

8. We have read and understood the TSP Guidelines 2026 and agree to be bound by the same unconditionally.

I/We agree to the above declaration and certify that the information provided in this application is true and correct to the best of my/our knowledge and belief. *
